description: Update one gap's status in the action queue (todo / doing / done). Use the gapKey and domain from list_gaps. e.g. mark the schema gap for acme.com done. WRITE ACTION — requires a Pro plan or higher; on Starter/trial the MCP is read-only.

domain.description: Bare domain the gap belongs to, e.g. 'acme.com'.

name: set_gap_status
